description: List raw objects owned by a Sui address with optional type filter and pagination. `count` covers every object of the page; the default view lists the objects that fit about 30k characters in page order and states the rest under `omitted`, and `detail: 'full'` lists the whole page. `next_cursor` continues after the whole page, rows under `omitted` included. For NFTs specifically, prefer list_nfts (resolves kiosk storage, extracts display metadata). For a wallet summary, prefer get_wallet_overview.

detail.description: 'summary' (default): the page's objects that fit about 30k characters, the rest in `omitted`. 'full': the whole page.

owner.description: Owner address (0x...). Required; `address` is accepted in its place.

name: list_owned_objects
title: List owned objects
